question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**from**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses traveling and specifically mentions the direction or starting point of the journey.
 
• The appropriate preposition should indicate moving away from a particular place.
 
• "**From**" fits well as it means indicating the starting point of the journey, which aligns with the context of traveling starting at a specific location.
 
• Other options ("**on**", "**since**", "**besides**") do not correctly describe the direction or starting point as intended in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *It is the mad* *craze__* *for speed that is responsible for many motor accidents. Only last year, I* *__witnessed__* *what might have been a* *__fatal__* *accident on Kashmir Road. I was motoring down* *__from__* *Srinagar; and as I was nearing Kohala, I came upon the* **________***of two cars on the road.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• On (पर): "On" indicates position or location on something, which does not fit the context of traveling from a place.
 
• Since (से): "Since" indicates time passed since a specific point, which does not align with the context of direction or starting point.
 
• Besides (के अलावा): "Besides" means in addition to, which does not fit the context of describing direction.
